mapper.select: SELECT A.MSG_NO AS msgNo , A.ARTIST_NM_KOR AS artistNmKor , C.ARTIST_NM_FOR AS artistNmFor , A.CONCERT_YEAR AS concertYear , A.CONCERT_MONTH AS concertMonth , A.CONCERT_DATE AS concertDate , A.SUBJECT AS subject , A.CONTENT AS content , A.ARTIST_IMAGE_URL AS artistImageUrl , DATE_FORMAT(A.REG_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS regTime FROM TB_ARTIST_MSG AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CONCERT_INFO AS C ON A.ARTIST_NM_KOR = C.ARTIST_NM_KOR AND A.CONCERT_YEAR = C.CONCERT_YEAR AND A.CONCERT_MONTH = C.CONCERT_MONTH AND A.CONCERT_DATE = C.CONCERT_DATE WHERE A.SEND_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.MSG_NO DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT A.MSG_NO AS msgNo , A.ARTIST_NM_KOR AS artistNmKor , C.ARTIST_NM_FOR AS artistNmFor , A.CONCERT_YEAR AS concertYear , A.CONCERT_MONTH AS concertMonth , A.CONCERT_DATE AS concertDate , A.SUBJECT AS subject , A.CONTENT AS content , A.ARTIST_IMAGE_URL AS artistImageUrl , DATE_FORMAT(A.REG_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS regTime FROM TB_ARTIST_MSG AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CONCERT_INFO AS C ON A.ARTIST_NM_KOR = C.ARTIST_NM_KOR AND A.CONCERT_YEAR = C.CONCERT_YEAR AND A.CONCERT_MONTH = C.CONCERT_MONTH AND A.CONCERT_DATE = C.CONCERT_DATE WHERE A.SEND_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.MSG_NO DESC LIMIT 5
